text:
I've planned a 12-show loop from Richmond with no days lost to driving. Every leg is under your 6-hour cap; the longest is Athens, OH to Bloomington, IN at about 5.4 hours (est.).

The route opens at Charlottesville (#5 nationally for fans of your comps) and Harrisonburg (#14). It then heads north and west to Pittsburgh (#10), Athens, OH (#11) and Bloomington, IN (#4). From there it goes south to Nashville (#17), Knoxville (#13) and Athens, GA (#3). It finishes in the Carolinas with Asheville (#1), Boone, Carrboro (#2) and Wilmington (#20). Boone is only there to break up the drive from Asheville to Carrboro, and it ranks #29 nationally. Everything else on the route ranks in the top 20.

Nine of the 12 stops are over-index towns, meaning towns under 250,000 people that rank in the national top 20. Nashville is the only stop on the usual big-city list. Burlington, Northampton and Portland, ME were left off because each would have taken a full day just to drive. Ithaca was within reach but didn't fit in 12 days.
